metadata.summary: A large-scale dataset for benchmarking medical question answering, sourced from professional medical board exam questions (USMLE-style), containing 12,723 question-answer pairs with explanations, covering multiple medical specialties and requiring multi-step clinical reasoning; includes a test split of 1,273 questions.
metadata.purpose: To advance research on medical knowledge question answering systems.

modality.scope: multiple medical specialties (e.g., internal medicine, pediatrics, surgery, psychiatry)

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identified; no protected health information (PHI) present — all content is publicly available exam material.

extraction.notes: 基线卡仅来自 dataset_catalog.xlsx 真实元数据；其余字段需论文/README 或人工补充。

known_limitations: Source limited to USMLE-style exams, reflecting US-centric medical curriculum and practice norms.
No demographic metadata (age, sex, ethnicity) for examinees or question authors.
Lack of real-world clinical context — questions are decontextualized exam items.
Potential cultural and linguistic bias limiting generalizability to non-English or non-US settings.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: USMLE exam takers are not representative of global clinicians or patients; overrepresents US-trained physicians.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup demographic data collected or reported.

population.target_population: US medical licensing exam candidates (USMLE test-takers)
population.missing_groups: Non-US medical trainees; non-English-speaking populations; underrepresented demographic groups in US medical education (not reported)

annotation.labeling_provenance: Questions and answers sourced directly from USMLE-style board exam materials; explanations provided by domain experts.
